name:        Selector
domain:      component
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Selector
description: A dropdown selector for choosing a single value from a list of options. Supports labels, validation, descriptions, and required/optional states. Use it in forms and settings when presenting a moderate number of options. Keyboard typeahead matches a native select: typing on the focused closed trigger selects the matching option directly, repeated presses cycle through options sharing a first letter, and spaces count as match characters ("new y" reaches "New York"). With the menu open, typing moves the highlight and Enter commits. With hasSearch, typing on the closed trigger opens the popup and seeds the search input.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Selector

name:        useCombobox
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Selector
description: Tracks the active option of a single-select combobox and handles its keys, while DOM focus stays on the control. It powers Selector and CommandPalette; use it to build a combobox those components do not cover, including one over a single-line text field you render yourself, such as a search field whose results replace a page section, or an "add people" field in a dialog. It renders nothing: you render the field, the listbox and the options, and spread `getFieldProps`, `getListboxProps` and `getOptionProps` onto them, or wire `role`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `aria-activedescendant` yourself from `onKeyDown` and `getItemId` for a control such as a button.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCombobox

name:        useLightbox
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Lightbox
description: State management and accessible trigger wiring for Lightbox. Eliminates boilerplate for managing open state and current index. Returns trigger props with button role, tabIndex={0}, aria-haspopup="dialog", and keyboard activation handlers, along with a pre-wired Lightbox element that handles dismissal, next/previous navigation, and focus restoration.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useLightbox

name:        useMenuPress
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: The press model of macOS and iOS menus, for any pointer: the row under the pointer when it is RELEASED is the row that acts, the highlight follows the pointer while it is held, a mouse opens the menu on press and can drag straight into it, and a finger held on the trigger opens it with the finger still down. The pointer is tracked at document level by pointerId, so a finger that slid off the row it landed on is still followed; the click the browser reports at the end of a touch, aimed at the row where the touch began, is swallowed so nothing acts twice. DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, DropdownMenuSubMenu, Selector and the menu bottom sheet already mount it; reach for it directly only when building a menu-like surface of your own.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useMenuPress

name:        useMultiCombobox
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MultiSelector
description: Tracks the active option of a multi-select combobox and handles its keys, while DOM focus stays on the control. It powers MultiSelector; unlike useCombobox, toggling an option keeps the list open, and rows can carry an action cell. It renders nothing and sets no attributes: the caller renders the control and the list, and wires the ARIA attributes from what it returns.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useMultiCombobox

name:        useTypeahead
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Adds APG type-to-focus search to a collection: printable keystrokes are buffered (resetting after a pause), and the first item whose label starts with the buffer (ignoring case, accents, the stroked letters đ ł ø ħ ŧ ƀ and Turkish ı/İ, the same in every locale; a typed accent prefers the exact match) is reported through onMatch. Pressing the same letter repeatedly cycles through the matches rather than filtering deeper. It moves nothing itself; pair it with the collection's own focus management, most often useListFocus or useGridFocus.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTypeahead
